subject: Help with the Listen directive in shiny-server.conf

messages.author: 8befd878828129b9
messages.subject: Help with the Listen directive in shiny-server.conf
parts:
The documentation for the Listen directive in shiny-server.conf is confusing: it says "the port parameter is an integer and the address is s string but only IPv4 addresses can be used at the moment, not hostnames. So how do I specify a port and IP address pair?

My server has an apache webserver bound to one address on port 80 and I want to bind the shiny-server to a second IP address, also on port 80.

Thanks in adance for any enlightenment.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Help with the Listen directive in shiny-server.conf
parts:
Let's say you wanted port 80 and address 10.0.0.2, it would look like this:

listen 80 10.0.0.2;
